reason: The cited evidence does not directly support the key premises for the WTaTiVZr alloy. E1 discusses deformation nano-twinning in an fcc CrCoNi medium-entropy alloy, not a bcc refractory HEA, and does not address lattice distortion effects on slip system activation or dynamic recovery. E2 mentions creep testing of HfTaTiVZr and TaTiVWZr but provides no data or mechanistic analysis linking lattice distortions to enhanced dislocation mobility or toughness. The premises rely on general concepts not substantiated by the specific cited passages.
premises: Severe lattice distortions in WTaTiVZr create heterogeneous internal stress fields
These stress fields lower activation barriers for multiple dislocation slip systems
Enhanced dislocation mobility promotes dynamic recovery at high temperature
This leads to more uniform plastic deformation and improved strain hardening
The alloy will exhibit superior toughness and plastic strain relative to pure tungsten
